verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU waali! Okufa,
Tokyayinza kututiisa:
Yesu yakuwangula;
Obulumi bwo bufudde!
Aleruuya!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu waali! bw'alijja,
Baliva-ababe mu bafu:
Yesu waali! Okufa,
Gwe mulyango gw'obulamu.
Aleruuya!

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Yesu waali! tewali,
Ddala kya kutwawukanya.
Atukuuma bulijjo
Buli wantu tatuleka.
Aleruuya!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Yesu waali! yaweebwa
-Obwakabaka bw'ensi zonna
Tulibeera wamu naye.
Aleruuya!
